policy: An approved source archive is legally cleared for this library. It is not automatically an approved runtime asset. Runtime admission requires an additional, individual technical and visual record.

requiredBeforeRuntimeAdmission: extract the exact candidate file without modifying the source archive
record per-file checksum and archive path
validate Godot import, scale, forward axis, pivot, and material slots
add collision, LOD, thumbnail, and visual-semantic review
entries.notes: Raw upstream package retained through Git LFS. No individual model from this package is currently claimed as engine-ready.
